messages:
Elena (Finance): FYI — launching a 6-week pilot next Monday for a new 'Adaptive Billing Buffer' that aims to reduce surprise overage invoices for small & mid customers. :wave:
Elena (Finance): TL;DR: customers get a temporary soft buffer tied to recent usage trends + auto-notify thresholds before we bill overage. Pilot is opt-in and limited to accounts < $5k/mo. Details: https://redwood.intern/docs/billing/adaptive-buffer
Marcus (Product): Nice. Does this impact rate-limiting behavior or just invoice smoothing?
Elena (Finance): Just billing/alerts and a small temporary buffer (2-10%) applied on invoicing math. No changes to runtime rate limits.
Priya (Sales): Helpful for SMBs. How do we surface opt-in in Console? Need a quick blurb for AE playbook.
Marcus (Product): Console will show a toggle in Billing → Billing Preferences. We'll add a tooltip and a short modal. I can draft the copy.
Jay (Eng): For accounting: what's the exact logic? Is it per-route or account-level? Any downstream data export changes?
Elena (Finance): Account-level. Buffer size is adaptive based on trailing-30-day 95th percentile usage. We'll add two CSV fields to invoice exports: buffer_applied and buffer_reason.
Sam (Support): We'll need canned support replies and a flow for customers who ask to opt-out retroactively. Can Legal confirm if we need consent language?
Nina (Legal): We'll review the modal copy. No major compliance concerns but we should be explicit that buffer is a temporary credit-like offset, not a refund. Add acceptance checkbox for the pilot.
Priya (Sales): Can we offer the pilot to specific inbound leads? e.g., startups we already want to retain?
Elena (Finance): Yes — opt-in can be triggered by account admin or manually by Sales via the admin console. We'll keep a record of manual enrollments.
Jay (Eng): Heads-up for eng: billing-bot will emit a webhook when buffer_applied > 0. We need to add a metric to routing to avoid any accidental double-counting in our internal cost reports.
Marcus (Product): I'll add a product ticket for the Console UX and one for the analytics signal change.
billing-bot: Automated note — pilot feature flag toggled to beta for accounts matching criteria starting 2025-01-06. See /ops/featureflags AZ-PILOT-234.
Sam (Support): Great. I'll prep the FAQ + sample scripts for how to explain estimations to customers.
Priya (Sales): Requesting a short email template we can use for proactive outreach.
Elena (Finance): I'll publish the pilot FAQ + AE email template by EOD Friday in the doc linked above. Please review and give feedback. :memo:
Marcus (Product): Thanks — want a quick sync Tuesday 11am to align on rollout comms?
Elena (Finance): Yep, booked. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
